author: Gforce40
body:
OK, so about a week ago, MiguelPlayz was doing a contest where he would randomly give someone a gold rank.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g1pOlWilPqI
I ended up winning the contest,
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=psylTB9DcCE
but a week and half has passed and nothing. I asked Ben Dooley about it and he told me to contact Miguel about it and if need be, report him. Well I e-mailed him through youtube and I got no response. I also tried to ask him on skype and again, same deal. http://imgur.com/qEDNISU . I ask that you guys try to talk to him somehow before punishing him. I can't talk to him ingame because he lives in singapore so when he is awake playing, I'm asleep. Thanks for the help!
